oracleAuthorship: Independent source-first authorship. No existing evaluation cases, reports, replay results, manifests, runtime response algorithm, or model outputs were consulted. Written guide data, approved base source overlays, and adapters solely for provenance mapping were consulted.
validationScope: 76 turns in 19 four-turn dialogues; Full answer, explicit game scope, no assumed player state. Expectations assert source-backed useful claims. Matching primary source tuple is exact on file, locator, review. AlternativeAnswers are frozen legitimate equivalent source paths; any selected path must satisfy its complete contains list and the requiredUsefulClaim. A sourceWitness string is a verbatim proof; an array gives separate verbatim proof clauses for a compound claim, all required. allSources, if present, requires every exact tuple in the response. No fact IDs are used.
